name: Mixiu Scru Cream Lip Care 11.5gm
description:
Product Name: Mixiu Scru Cream Lip Care
Type: Propolis Lip Exfoliator Gel / Lipcare Cream
Net Weight: 11.5g

Key Benefits

Anti-Aging: Helps reduce fine lines and wrinkles on lips

Whitening & Brightening: Removes blemishes and enhances natural lip color

Hydrating & Moisturizing: Strong water-lock effect keeps lips soft and supple

Exfoliating: Removes dead skin cells for smoother, more vibrant lips

Natural Ingredients: Made with 100% natural components for gentle care

Skin Care: Improves overall lip texture and moisture retention

Usage Effects

Moisturizes and protects lips

Leaves lips soft, smooth, and visually brighter

Enhances lip color by removing dead skin
